/-!
# Rounded dot products on binary reduction trees

The statement follows `/spec/source.txt`. Each leaf incurs one multiplication
rounding, and each leaf-to-root path incurs at most `tree.depth` addition
roundings. The supplied prerequisite modules are copied unchanged.

Statement revision record: this is the initial statement; no feedback file was
present and no prior statement was revised.
-/

namespace Research.BinaryTreeReduction

open Research.FloatingPoint

noncomputable section

/-- The exact componentwise products, retaining the input reduction shape. -/
def exactProductTree (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : Tree ℝ :=
  tree.map (fun p => p.1 * p.2)

/-- Round each componentwise product, retaining the input reduction shape. -/
def roundedProductTree (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : Tree ℝ :=
  tree.map (fun p => model.mul p.1 p.2)

/-- Round the products and then perform rounded addition along the given tree. -/
def roundedDotProduct (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) : ℝ :=
  roundedSum model (roundedProductTree model tree)

@[simp] theorem depth_exactProductTree (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    (exactProductTree tree).depth = tree.depth := by
  exact Tree.depth_map _ tree

@[simp] theorem depth_roundedProductTree (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    (roundedProductTree model tree).depth = tree.depth := by
  exact Tree.depth_map _ tree

/-- For every abstract relative-error model and every binary tree of pairs,
the rounded dot product is the exact sum of a same-shape tree of perturbed
exact products. The bound accounts for the multiplication at each leaf and
all additions on its path to the root, including the single-leaf case.

The only additional hypothesis is `(depth + 1) * u < 1`; nonnegativity of `u`
and the rounding specification are fields of the supplied `Model`.
-/
theorem roundedDotProduct_exists_perturbation
    (model : Model) (tree : Tree (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hsmall : ((tree.depth + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * model.u < 1) :
    ∃ perturbed : Tree ℝ,
      IsPerturbation (gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u)
        (exactProductTree tree) perturbed ∧
      perturbed.exactSum = roundedDotProduct model tree := by
  sorry

end

end Research.BinaryTreeReduction

import Mathlib

/-!
# Abstract floating-point model

This is the standard relative-error model used by the binary-tree project,
not a bit-level formalization of IEEE 754.
-/

namespace Research.FloatingPoint

/-- A rounding operation satisfying the standard relative-error model.
The specification covers operations for which overflow and underflow do not occur.
-/
structure Model where
  u : ℝ
  u_nonneg : 0 ≤ u
  round : ℝ → ℝ
  round_spec : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ δ : ℝ, |δ| ≤ u ∧ round z = z * (1 + δ)

/-- Floating-point addition induced by an abstract rounding model. -/
def Model.add (model : Model) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  model.round (a + b)

/-- Floating-point multiplication induced by an abstract rounding model. -/
def Model.mul (model : Model) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  model.round (a * b)

end Research.FloatingPoint
import Research.Common.FloatingPoint.Model

/-! # Accumulated relative error -/

namespace Research.FloatingPoint

/-- Standard bound for `k` accumulated relative errors of size at most `u`. -/
noncomputable def gamma (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (k : ℝ) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u)

@[simp] theorem gamma_zero (u : ℝ) : gamma 0 u = 0 := by
  simp [gamma]

/-- The product of the relative-error factors in a list. -/
def errorProduct (errors : List ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (errors.map fun δ => 1 + δ).prod

@[simp] theorem errorProduct_nil : errorProduct [] = 1 := by
  simp [errorProduct]

@[simp] theorem errorProduct_cons (δ : ℝ) (errors : List ℝ) :
    errorProduct (δ :: errors) = (1 + δ) * errorProduct errors := by
  simp [errorProduct]

/-- `gamma` is nonnegative whenever its denominator is positive. -/
theorem gamma_nonneg (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hsmall : (k : ℝ) * u < 1) :
    0 ≤ gamma k u := by
  unfold gamma
  exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hu) (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hsmall))

/-- The algebraic step used when one more rounding-error factor is added. -/
theorem gamma_step (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hsmall : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * u < 1) :
    gamma k u + u * (1 + gamma k u) ≤ gamma (k + 1) u := by
  have hk_nonneg : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hk_small : (k : ℝ) * u < 1 := by
    norm_num at hsmall ⊢
    nlinarith
  have hk_denom : 0 < 1 - (k : ℝ) * u := sub_pos.mpr hk_small
  have hsucc_denom : 0 < 1 - ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * u := sub_pos.mpr hsmall
  rw [gamma, gamma]
  norm_num at hsmall ⊢
  have hleft :
      (k : ℝ) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u) +
          u * (1 + (k : ℝ) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u)) =
        ((k : ℝ) + 1) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u) := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hk_denom]
    ring
  rw [hleft]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left
    (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hu)
    (by norm_num at hsucc_denom ⊢; exact hsucc_denom)
    (by nlinarith)

/-- A product of `k` relative-error factors differs from one by at most
`gamma k u`, provided each individual error is at most `u` and `k*u < 1`.
-/
theorem errorProduct_sub_one_abs_le_gamma (errors : List ℝ) (u : ℝ)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hsmall : (errors.length : ℝ) * u < 1)
    (herrors : ∀ δ ∈ errors, |δ| ≤ u) :
    |errorProduct errors - 1| ≤ gamma errors.length u := by
  induction errors with
  | nil => simp
  | cons δ errors ih =>
      have hδ : |δ| ≤ u := herrors δ (by simp)
      have htail : ∀ ε ∈ errors, |ε| ≤ u := by
        intro ε hε
        exact herrors ε (by simp [hε])
      have htail_small : (errors.length : ℝ) * u < 1 := by
        norm_num at hsmall ⊢
        nlinarith
      have ih_bound := ih htail_small htail
      have hgamma_nonneg : 0 ≤ gamma errors.length u :=
        gamma_nonneg errors.length u hu htail_small
      have hproduct_abs : |errorProduct errors| ≤ 1 + gamma errors.length u := by
        calc
          |errorProduct errors| = |(errorProduct errors - 1) + 1| := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ |errorProduct errors - 1| + |(1 : ℝ)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ gamma errors.length u + 1 := by norm_num; linarith
          _ = 1 + gamma errors.length u := by ring
      calc
        |errorProduct (δ :: errors) - 1|
            = |(errorProduct errors - 1) + δ * errorProduct errors| := by
                rw [errorProduct_cons]
                congr 1
                ring
        _ ≤ |errorProduct errors - 1| + |δ * errorProduct errors| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |errorProduct errors - 1| + |δ| * |errorProduct errors| := by
              rw [abs_mul]
        _ ≤ gamma errors.length u + u * (1 + gamma errors.length u) := by
              gcongr
        _ ≤ gamma (errors.length + 1) u := gamma_step errors.length u hu (by
              norm_num at hsmall ⊢
              exact hsmall)
        _ = gamma (δ :: errors).length u := by simp

end Research.FloatingPoint
import Mathlib

/-! # Binary reduction trees -/

namespace Research.BinaryTreeReduction

/-- A binary reduction tree with data stored at its leaves. -/
inductive Tree (α : Type*) where
  | leaf : α → Tree α
  | node : Tree α → Tree α → Tree α
  deriving Repr

namespace Tree

/-- Apply a function to every leaf while preserving the reduction shape. -/
def map (f : α → β) : Tree α → Tree β
  | leaf value => leaf (f value)
  | node left right => node (map f left) (map f right)

/-- Number of internal nodes on the longest root-to-leaf path. -/
def depth : Tree α → ℕ
  | leaf _ => 0
  | node left right => 1 + max left.depth right.depth

/-- Number of leaves in a tree. -/
def leafCount : Tree α → ℕ
  | leaf _ => 1
  | node left right => left.leafCount + right.leafCount

/-- Exact real-valued sum represented by a reduction tree. -/
def exactSum : Tree ℝ → ℝ
  | leaf value => value
  | node left right => left.exactSum + right.exactSum

/-- Multiply every leaf in a tree by the same scalar. -/
def scale (c : ℝ) : Tree ℝ → Tree ℝ
  | leaf value => leaf (c * value)
  | node left right => node (scale c left) (scale c right)

@[simp] theorem depth_leaf (x : α) : (leaf x).depth = 0 := rfl
@[simp] theorem leafCount_leaf (x : α) : (leaf x).leafCount = 1 := rfl

@[simp] theorem depth_map (f : α → β) (tree : Tree α) :
    (tree.map f).depth = tree.depth := by
  induction tree with
  | leaf value => rfl
  | node left right ihLeft ihRight => simp [map, depth, ihLeft, ihRight]

@[simp] theorem exactSum_leaf (x : ℝ) : (leaf x).exactSum = x := rfl

@[simp] theorem exactSum_node (left right : Tree ℝ) :
    (node left right).exactSum = left.exactSum + right.exactSum := rfl

@[simp] theorem exactSum_scale (c : ℝ) (tree : Tree ℝ) :
    (scale c tree).exactSum = c * tree.exactSum := by
  induction tree with
  | leaf value => rfl
  | node left right ihLeft ihRight =>
      simp only [scale, exactSum_node, ihLeft, ihRight]
      ring

end Tree
end Research.BinaryTreeReduction
import Research.Common.FloatingPoint.Gamma
import Research.Projects.BinaryTreeReduction.Algorithm

/-! # Floating-point binary-tree reduction -/

namespace Research.BinaryTreeReduction

open Research.FloatingPoint

/-- Evaluate a tree using floating-point addition at every internal node. -/
def roundedSum (model : Model) : Tree ℝ → ℝ
  | .leaf value => value
  | .node left right => model.add (roundedSum model left) (roundedSum model right)

/-- `perturbed` has the same shape as `original`, and each perturbed leaf
differs from its original value by at most `bound * |value|`. -/
inductive IsPerturbation (bound : ℝ) : Tree ℝ → Tree ℝ → Prop where
  | leaf (x y : ℝ) (error_le : |y - x| ≤ bound * |x|) :
      IsPerturbation bound (.leaf x) (.leaf y)
  | node {left left' right right' : Tree ℝ}
      (left_ok : IsPerturbation bound left left')
      (right_ok : IsPerturbation bound right right') :
      IsPerturbation bound (.node left right) (.node left' right')

namespace IsPerturbation

/-- A leafwise perturbation remains valid when its nonnegative bound grows. -/
theorem mono {original perturbed : Tree ℝ} {bound nextBound : ℝ}
    (h : IsPerturbation bound original perturbed)
    (hbound : bound ≤ nextBound) :
    IsPerturbation nextBound original perturbed := by
  induction h with
  | leaf x y error_le =>
      apply IsPerturbation.leaf
      exact error_le.trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbound (abs_nonneg x))
  | node left_ok right_ok ihLeft ihRight =>
      exact IsPerturbation.node ihLeft ihRight

/-- Compose two leafwise relative perturbations. -/
theorem trans {original middle perturbed : Tree ℝ} {first second : ℝ}
    (hFirst : IsPerturbation first original middle)
    (hSecond : IsPerturbation second middle perturbed)
    (hsecond_nonneg : 0 ≤ second) :
    IsPerturbation (first + second * (1 + first)) original perturbed := by
  induction hFirst generalizing perturbed with
  | leaf x y first_error =>
      cases hSecond with
      | leaf _ z second_error =>
          apply IsPerturbation.leaf
          have hy : |y| ≤ (1 + first) * |x| := by
            calc
              |y| = |(y - x) + x| := by ring_nf
              _ ≤ |y - x| + |x| := abs_add_le _ _
              _ ≤ first * |x| + |x| := add_le_add first_error le_rfl
              _ = (1 + first) * |x| := by ring
          calc
            |z - x| = |(z - y) + (y - x)| := by
              congr 1
              ring
            _ ≤ |z - y| + |y - x| := abs_add_le _ _
            _ ≤ second * |y| + first * |x| :=
              add_le_add second_error first_error
            _ ≤ second * ((1 + first) * |x|) + first * |x| := by
              gcongr
            _ = (first + second * (1 + first)) * |x| := by ring
  | node left_ok right_ok ihLeft ihRight =>
      cases hSecond with
      | node secondLeft secondRight =>
          exact IsPerturbation.node
            (ihLeft secondLeft) (ihRight secondRight)

/-- Multiplying every perturbed leaf by one more relative-error factor
updates the leafwise error bound by `bound + u * (1 + bound)`. -/
theorem scale_one_add {original perturbed : Tree ℝ} {bound nextBound u δ : ℝ}
    (h : IsPerturbation bound original perturbed)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (hδ : |δ| ≤ u)
    (hnext : bound + u * (1 + bound) ≤ nextBound) :
    IsPerturbation nextBound original (Tree.scale (1 + δ) perturbed) := by
  induction h with
  | leaf x y error_le =>
      apply IsPerturbation.leaf
      have hy : |y| ≤ (1 + bound) * |x| := by
        calc
          |y| = |(y - x) + x| := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ |y - x| + |x| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ bound * |x| + |x| := add_le_add error_le le_rfl
          _ = (1 + bound) * |x| := by ring
      calc
        |(1 + δ) * y - x| = |(y - x) + δ * y| := by
          congr 1
          ring
        _ ≤ |y - x| + |δ * y| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |y - x| + |δ| * |y| := by rw [abs_mul]
        _ ≤ bound * |x| + u * ((1 + bound) * |x|) := by
          gcongr
        _ = (bound + u * (1 + bound)) * |x| := by ring
        _ ≤ nextBound * |x| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnext (abs_nonneg x)
  | node left_ok right_ok ihLeft ihRight =>
      exact IsPerturbation.node ihLeft ihRight

end IsPerturbation

/-- A tree whose depth is at most `k` evaluates in floating point as the exact
sum of leaf values perturbed by at most `gamma k u`.

The model's specification incorporates the assumption that every operation
under consideration avoids overflow and underflow.
-/
theorem roundedSum_exists_perturbation_of_depth_le
    (model : Model) (k : ℕ) (tree : Tree ℝ)
    (hdepth : tree.depth ≤ k)
    (hsmall : (k : ℝ) * model.u < 1) :
    ∃ perturbed : Tree ℝ,
      IsPerturbation (gamma k model.u) tree perturbed ∧
      perturbed.exactSum = roundedSum model tree := by
  induction k generalizing tree with
  | zero =>
      cases tree with
      | leaf x =>
          refine ⟨.leaf x, ?_, rfl⟩
          apply IsPerturbation.leaf
          simp
      | node left right =>
          simp [Tree.depth] at hdepth
  | succ k ih =>
      cases tree with
      | leaf x =>
          refine ⟨.leaf x, ?_, rfl⟩
          apply IsPerturbation.leaf
          have hgamma : 0 ≤ gamma (k + 1) model.u :=
            gamma_nonneg (k + 1) model.u model.u_nonneg (by
              norm_num at hsmall ⊢
              exact hsmall)
          simpa using mul_nonneg hgamma (abs_nonneg x)
      | node left right =>
          have hleft_depth : left.depth ≤ k := by
            simp only [Tree.depth] at hdepth
            omega
          have hright_depth : right.depth ≤ k := by
            simp only [Tree.depth] at hdepth
            omega
          have htail_small : (k : ℝ) * model.u < 1 := by
            norm_num at hsmall ⊢
            nlinarith [model.u_nonneg]
          obtain ⟨left', left_ok, left_sum⟩ := ih left hleft_depth htail_small
          obtain ⟨right', right_ok, right_sum⟩ := ih right hright_depth htail_small
          obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hround⟩ :=
            model.round_spec (roundedSum model left + roundedSum model right)
          let scaledLeft := Tree.scale (1 + δ) left'
          let scaledRight := Tree.scale (1 + δ) right'
          refine ⟨Tree.node scaledLeft scaledRight, ?_, ?_⟩
          · apply IsPerturbation.node
            · exact left_ok.scale_one_add
                model.u_nonneg hδ
                (gamma_step k model.u model.u_nonneg (by
                  norm_num at hsmall ⊢
                  exact hsmall))
            · exact right_ok.scale_one_add
                model.u_nonneg hδ
                (gamma_step k model.u model.u_nonneg (by
                  norm_num at hsmall ⊢
                  exact hsmall))
          · simp only [scaledLeft, scaledRight, Tree.exactSum_node,
              Tree.exactSum_scale]
            rw [left_sum, right_sum]
            simp only [roundedSum, Model.add]
            rw [hround]
            ring

/-- Backward-error theorem specialized to the actual depth of a tree. -/
theorem roundedSum_exists_perturbation
    (model : Model) (tree : Tree ℝ)
    (hsmall : (tree.depth : ℝ) * model.u < 1) :
    ∃ perturbed : Tree ℝ,
      IsPerturbation (gamma tree.depth model.u) tree perturbed ∧
      perturbed.exactSum = roundedSum model tree :=
  roundedSum_exists_perturbation_of_depth_le model tree.depth tree le_rfl hsmall

/-- Algorithm 1 specialized backward-error theorem for every nonempty input
list. The constructed tree preserves the inputs, has logarithmic depth, and
its rounded result is the exact sum of leafwise-perturbed inputs. -/
theorem algorithm1_exists_perturbation
    (model : Model) (inputs : List ℝ) (hinputs : inputs ≠ [])
    (hsmall : (Nat.clog 2 inputs.length : ℝ) * model.u < 1) :
    ∃ tree perturbed : Tree ℝ,
      reductionTree inputs = some tree ∧
      tree.leafMultiset = inputs ∧
      tree.depth ≤ Nat.clog 2 inputs.length ∧
      IsPerturbation (gamma (Nat.clog 2 inputs.length) model.u) tree perturbed ∧
      perturbed.exactSum = roundedSum model tree := by
  obtain ⟨tree, htree, hleaves, hdepth⟩ := reductionTree_spec hinputs
  obtain ⟨perturbed, hperturbed, hsum⟩ :=
    roundedSum_exists_perturbation_of_depth_le model
      (Nat.clog 2 inputs.length) tree hdepth hsmall
  exact ⟨tree, perturbed, htree, hleaves, hdepth, hperturbed, hsum⟩

end Research.BinaryTreeReduction
